scripts.package:obsidian: pnpm --filter @hexfield-deck/obsidian-plugin build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('obsidian-dist',{recursive:true});['main.js','manifest.json','styles.css'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(path.join('packages/obsidian-plugin',f),path.join('obsidian-dist',f)));console.log('Obsidian plugin ready in obsidian-dist/');"
